newsitem.title: THAILAND: Oil spill threatens eastern Thai coast.
newsitem.headline: Oil spill threatens eastern Thai coast.

text.p: Thai officials and executives of Star Petroleum Refining Co met on Thursday to find ways for containing a crude oil spill off the south eastern Thai coast.

An official of a public relations firm representing Star Petroleum said company executives worked with the Harbour Department and the Thai navy to minimise environmental damage from the spill on Wednesday in waters about 19 kms (12 miles) off the eastern Rayong province.
About 1,000 barrels of crude oil leaked into the sea during its routine transfer from Star Petroleum's chartered tanker to the company's floating storage facility moored off Rayong.
The spill was spotted after the tanker discharged about half its 1.9 million barrels of crude.
Star Petroleum said it commissioned anti oil-spill specialists of Singapore-based East Asia Response Ltd to help cordon off oil slicks.
